<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 16"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Too Much to Swallow](/Feats.aspx?ID=5408) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Druid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=583" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 57

**Prerequisites**
[Untamed Form](/Feats.aspx?ID=4713)

**Trigger**
You’re subject to an effect you could attempt to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296).

</column>

---

While you might be small enough to grab normally, you can change that at a moment's notice. You cast [_untamed form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1861). If you took on a new form that's too large for the effect, you automatically escape. Otherwise, you attempt to Escape. If this ends an effect where you entered the creature's space, such as [Swallow Whole](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=77), exit that creature to an adjacent area where your new form could fit.
name: Too Much to Swallow
